verdict.rationale: Manufact lets developers deploy and host their own MCP servers with public MCP URLs, offers a "publish workflow" with readiness checks, and lists public checklist scores in an mcp-catalog. Connect-clients also offers one-click installs into editors. However, the evidence does not show a marketplace where other users can discover and install published servers; the catalog is described only in terms of checklist scores, and one-click installs appear aimed at connecting your own server. Missing for 10: a documented public listing/marketplace flow for distribution to other users, documented discovery and search of third-party servers, install-by-others workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish my own MCP server on the platform for distribution, discovery, and installation by others
